propertyDetails.description: 5 Bedroom home located in sought after Pinehurst Neighborhood. Well maintained by second owner for almost 50 years. Popular floor plan with 4 spacious bedrooms upstairs and 1 ground floor bedroom.  Lovely open formal dining and living room combination.  Fireplace in living room.  Hardwood flooring in L/R & D/R and all bedrooms. Granite counter top in kitchen. Indoor laundry/mudroom with washer dryer and freezer. Spacious backyard with patio and mature landscape. Optional Cabana Club offering a wonderful community feel and competitive Piranha swim team. Easy access to major freeway and downtown San Jose.  This is a "must see" home!
